blocks.text: Is chapter mein hum gurdon ki banawat aur kaam, aur jab yeh nizam kamzor ho jaye to istemal hone wali zindagi bachane wali technologies dekhenge.

blocks.title: Excretion (ikhraj)
blocks.text: Excretion woh amal hai jis se jaandar apne metabolic fuzlaat (waste) bahar nikalta hai: nitrogeni fuzlaat, zaid pani aur zaid namak. Insanon mein yeh kaam urinary (excretory) system karta hai.

items: Nitrogeni fuzlaat ka ikhraj: urea ko chhaan kar nikalna, jo jigar mein protein tootne se banne wala nitrogeni fuzla hai.
Osmoregulation: khoon mein pani aur namak ka tawazun (balance) rakhna, yeh tay kar ke ke kitna pani wapas liya ya nikala jaye.
pH aur ions ka qaboo: sodium, potassium aur hydrogen ions ka tawazun ta ke khoon thora basic, taqreeban pH 7.4, rahe.

Do gurde (kidneys), pait ki cavity ke oopar wale hisse mein reerh ki haddi (vertebral column) ke dono taraf, 12wen thoracic aur 3re lumbar vertebrae ke darmiyan. Jigar ki wajah se dayan gurda baen se thora neeche aur chhota hai. 11wen aur 12wen pasliyan (ribs) un ke oopar wale hisse ko kuch hifazat deti hain.
Do ureters, taqreeban 25 cm lambi nalyan. Har aik apne gurde ke keep-numa (funnel) renal pelvis se shuru ho kar peshab neeche bladder tak le jati hai.
Aik urinary bladder, pelvic cavity mein khokhla, phailne wala muscular uzv jo peshab jama karta hai.
Aik urethra, woh nali jo peshab ko bladder se jism ke bahar le jati hai.

blocks.alt: Dhar (trunk) ka saamne ka manzar aur peshab ka nizam: pait ke oopar do gurde, inferior vena cava (neeli) aur aorta (laal) ke qareeb; har gurde se ureter neeche pelvis mein peshab ki thaili (urinary bladder) tak, aur bladder ke neeche urethra. Tasveer mein baayan gurda poora hai aur dayan kaat kar dikhaya gaya hai taa ke renal pelvis nazar aaye.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.1: Insani excretory (urinary) nizam (kitab ki Figure 14.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Hilum, Kidney, Renal pelvis, Ureter, Urinary bladder, Urethra. Dekhne wale ke baayen wala gurda doosre se thora neeche hai.

blocks.title: Sochne ki baat
blocks.text: Bari aant (large intestine) ko bara excretory uzv kyun nahi kaha jata? Excretion metabolic fuzlaat nikalta hai, jo jism ki apni chemistry se bante hain; faeces zyada tar ghair hazam khurak hai jo kabhi jism ke cells mein dakhil hi nahi hui, is liye inhein nikalna egestion hai. (Yeh jawab aam biology hai, kitab mein chhapa nahi.)

blocks.prompt: Urinary system ke aaza us tarteeb se likhiye jis mein peshab un se guzarta hai.
blocks.explanation: Gurde (peshab banta aur renal pelvis mein jama hota hai), ureters, urinary bladder, urethra.

items: Excretion metabolic fuzlaat nikalta hai; urinary system urea nikalta, osmoregulation karta aur khoon ka pH 7.4 ke qareeb rakhta hai.
Aaza: 2 gurde, 2 ureters (25 cm), bladder, urethra; dayan gurda neeche aur chhota.
